sources.dateOrElection: Electoral Act 1993, version 238.0 as at 1 January 2026
limitations: Text extraction of the official PDF uploaded by the project requester; the original PDF and a direct download were not available to the session, so only this extraction is checksummed.
Statute text is rules evidence, not election data; sections used are ss 3, 35, 45, 127A, 153-153E, 179 and 191-193.
No processing script: the text is read by hand for rule verification (docs/mmp-rules-verification.md); src/models/mmp/allocate.ts implements ss 191-193 directly.
